svg.title: The British Sector of the Western Front: Terrain, Battles & Medical Evacuation (1914–1918)
svg.desc: Edexcel GCSE History GIS map of Flanders and Northern France showing the English Channel, Calais, Boulogne and Étaples Base Hospitals (18%, 28%), the waterlogged Ypres Salient (58%, 26%), Arras and its underground chalk caves (53%, 56%), the Somme battlefield (55%, 76%), Cambrai and Capt. Robertson's first blood bank (68%, 66%), and westward rail and canal evacuation routes.
